title: Tiny, cute trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell of trumpet -->
  <path d='M18 38 Q10 36 8 30 Q6 22 14 20 Q22 18 28 24 L34 30 L28 42 Z' fill='#FFD93D' stroke='#FFB300' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Bell inner glow -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='30' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#FFE97A'/>
  <!-- Bell rim highlight -->
  <path d='M8 24 Q10 20 16 19' fill='none' stroke='#FFF3B0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Main tube body -->
  <rect x='28' y='36' width='42' height='10' rx='5' fill='#FFAB40'/>
  <!-- Tube highlight -->
  <rect x='30' y='37' width='38' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFD180'/>
  <!-- Tube shading -->
  <rect x='30' y='43' width='38' height='2' rx='1' fill='#E69138'/>
  
  <!-- Valve casing 1 -->
  <rect x='36' y='26' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <rect x='37' y='27' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  
  <!-- Valve casing 2 -->
  <rect x='46' y='24' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <rect x='47' y='25' width='2' height='14' rx='1' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  
  <!-- Valve casing 3 -->
  <rect x='56' y='26' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <rect x='57' y='27' width='2' height='12' rx='1' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  
  <!-- Valve caps round tops -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='26' r='4' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='26' r='2' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='24' r='4' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='24' r='2' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='26' r='4' fill='#FFE082'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='26' r='2' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
  
  <!-- Leadpipe / mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='68' y='38' width='18' height='6' rx='3' fill='#FFAB40'/>
  <!-- Mouthpiece cup -->
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='41' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <ellipse cx='88' cy='41' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFF3B0'/>
  
  <!-- Slide / extra tube -->
  <rect x='32' y='46' width='28' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#F4A030'/>
  <rect x='34' y='47' width='24' height='1.5' rx='0.75' fill='#FFC866'/>
  
  <!-- Water key tiny detail -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='2' fill='#FFE082'/>
  
  <!-- Cute face on bell -->
  <circle cx='14' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#5B2C00'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#5B2C00'/>
  <path d='M13 33 Q18 37 23 33' fill='none' stroke='#5B2C00' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='10' cy='31' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='31' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#FF8A65' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Sparkle -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='35' r='1' fill='#FFF8E1'/>
</svg>
